checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same matte black bottle recognizable, shape and details preserved
must.why: Shape, cap loop, ring grooves and base line match the original closely.

must.item: Bottle on light stone kitchen counter, not wooden table
must.why: Cream travertine-like counter replaces the wood.
Cabinets, backsplash, stove and cutting board appear softly blurred; fairly tidy.

must.item: Clean edges and believable contact shadow, not floating
must.why: Edges are clean, and a soft shadow falls to the right of the base, so the bottle sits grounded.

faults.what: Background is slightly cluttered and somewhat unclear on the right (stove and utensil), but it is plausible.

summary: The bottle was kept faithfully and placed on a light stone counter in front of a blurred modern kitchen, with a believable shadow. Only minor background and resolution issues remain.
